tools.name: get_daily_brief

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account_status, get_company_profile, get_matching_status, get_pipeline, get_insights, get_change_status, get_tender_decision · Public sink: update_company_profile · Destructive: search_tenders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account_status, get_company_profile, get_matching_status, get_pipeline, get_insights, get_change_status, get_tender_decision · Public sink: update_company_profile · Destructive: search_tenders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
